knownLimitations: The Heavy Ball test fixture's multiMetadata helper supplies minimumCount/maximumCount for prize-slots, but Agent49 multiSelectBounds reads requiredCount; the request is rejected before policy execution. No fixture edit was made under init-only scope.
No native games, fixtures, source-natural states, or native-staged cases were run.
The Apex Dragon helper dependency is shared with Agent43; only the wrapper's rank-12 Noivern priorities and exact-printing bindings are rank-specific.
The rank-12 source includes a Noivern ex payload that is used from discard; the policy does not attempt to evolve it onto the board.
Phantom Dive damage placement is deliberately unsupported and fails closed.
Path to the Peak is conservatively withheld while own Rule Box abilities may still be needed.
Counter Catcher prompt target choice is tested separately from its Prize-count eligibility gate.
Candidate and bundle producer IDs are intentionally null; no V3 attestation is possible.
No win-rate or competitive-strength claim is made.
The Heavy Ball prompt fixture needs a separately authorized multi-select-bounds correction; no fixture change was made under the zero-key init scope.
